title: 4-bit Counter with Enable
constraints: `count` is 4 bits wide and wraps from 15 to 0.
`rst` is synchronous and active-high, and has priority over `en`.
`count` may only change on a rising edge of `clk`.
hints: A single clocked block is enough: `always @(posedge clk)`, `always_ff @(posedge clk)` or a `rising_edge(clk)` process.
Test `rst` inside the clocked block. Putting it in the sensitivity list (`or posedge rst`) makes the reset asynchronous — the testbench checks for that.
In VHDL keep the value in an `unsigned(3 downto 0)` signal; `cnt + 1` then wraps from 15 to 0 by itself.

examples.title: reset
examples.input: rst = 1 for one clock edge, then rst = 0, en = 0

examples.title: synchronous reset
examples.input: count = 5, raise rst between two clock edges
examples.expected: count stays 5 until the next rising edge, then becomes 0
